entities.summary: Karl Jakob Heinrich Brenner - also Karl-Heinrich Brenner - was a decorated German general of the Waffen-SS who held the rank of SS-Gruppenführer and Generalleutnant of the Police during the Nazi era. He was a recipient of the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross of Nazi Germany.
